findings.issue: Unbounded module-level cache whose keys include request-derived path segments (pokemon-species/<url param> from app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:26); 404 results are cached forever and never evicted, so crawling or fuzzing URLs grows server memory without limit.
findings.suggestion: Only cache paths you can validate against a known collection (or apply an LRU bound / TTL eviction), and don't cache negative lookups keyed by user input.

findings.issue: Stale-while-revalidate sets hit.at = now before the refresh resolves and swallows refresh errors in an empty catch, so a failed revalidation pins stale data and suppresses retry for another full 60s window.
findings.suggestion: Update the entry timestamp only in the success callback (the existing promise.then at line 51-53) and either retry or drop the entry on failure.

findings.issue: The team cookie contract (name 'team', comma-separated format, TEAM_SIZE = 6) is implemented three times: lib/team.ts on the server and two inline client scripts (TeamButton.astro:20-28, team.astro:78-87), so the constant and format can drift.
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared src/lib/team-cookie.ts (cookie name, size, read/write) and import it from both Astro <script> blocks — Astro bundles script imports natively.

findings.issue: The 'fetch page → DOMParser → replaceWith(#id)' partial-update pattern is duplicated three times (index.astro:96-137, MovesSection.astro:184-206, team.astro:88-100) with divergent popstate and error-fallback behavior.
findings.suggestion: Extract one small client helper (e.g. swapFragment(url, containerId, {onError})) and use it in all three places so behavior is consistent and testable.

findings.issue: Non-404 API errors throw out of the data layer and surface as a bare 500 from the Node adapter on every route, with no user-facing error state.
findings.suggestion: Add a custom 500 page or catch API errors at the page boundary and render a friendly error (or fall back to NotFound) instead of letting the framework default leak.

findings.issue: Non-null assertions on querySelector('[data-filters]') and the search input mean any markup rename turns into a runtime TypeError in the browser.
findings.suggestion: Guard with an early return (if (!form) return;) so the script degrades silently, or type the element via a ref-style attribute check.

findings.issue: getHomeEntries rebuilds the 1025-entry list plus two index maps (typesById, genById) on every request; only the raw fetches are cached, not the derived result.
findings.suggestion: Memoize the derived HomeEntry[] alongside the fetch cache with the same freshness window, so the home page does O(2k) work per request.

findings.issue: API records are handled as 'any' throughout (types, abilities, stats), so typos in property names would fail silently and the spec's field mapping is untyped.
findings.suggestion: Define minimal interfaces for the PokeAPI records used (Pokemon, Species, Type, Move) in lib/pokedex.ts and reuse them across pages.

summary: This is a well-crafted Astro 7 app: current-stable version, idiomatic SSR with correct 404 semantics, a clean lib/ data layer, and careful a11y and client-enhancement details. The merge blockers are localized: an unbounded request-keyed cache and a stale-pin in the SWR logic, plus the team-cookie contract and fragment-swap pattern being copy-pasted across two or three files each. One small round of changes gets it to approve.
